Overview

About Textile Grant

Textile manufacturing, processing and garmenting units can access grant assistance for new capacity, modernisation, product development and eco-friendly processes. Support is available under central textile schemes and state textile policies such as Gujarat's.

The grant typically covers up to 50% of the eligible project cost, capped at ₹50 Lakh, and can be combined with capital subsidy under TUFS and interest subsidy from the state. We identify the best combination for your unit and manage the applications together.

Key benefits

  • Grant of up to ₹50 Lakh towards the eligible project cost
  • Encourages capacity expansion, new products and innovation
  • Improves productivity and competitiveness of the unit
  • Supports sustainable and eco-friendly processing practices
  • Can be stacked with TUFS capital subsidy and state incentives

Who is eligible

  • Textile manufacturing units covering spinning, weaving, knitting, processing and garmenting
  • Weavers, spinners, dyers and textile MSMEs
  • Exporters and textile entrepreneurs setting up new units
  • Startups in the textile and technical textile sector
  • Udyam registration and a valid factory or business licence

Documents required

  • Udyam registration and company documents
  • Detailed project report with machinery list and quotations
  • Audited financials and bank statements
  • Land, building and power documents for the unit
  • Pollution and factory licences where applicable
